gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-002 identifies that the theorem proves only a liminf result while incorrectly asserting monotone convergence of the raw objective sequence, and it gives the correct running-best replacement.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: Both concern the false inference and statement that the raw GD objective values decrease monotonically to kappa_*, despite only liminf convergence being established; the monotone conclusion applies to the running minimum instead.

component_coverage.gold_component: The theorem falsely claims monotone full-sequence convergence of the raw objective values, whereas only liminf convergence is justified and monotonicity applies to the running-best values.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction explicitly distinguishes the proved liminf statement from the unsupported raw-sequence monotonicity claim and supplies the running-minimum correction.

gold_decisions.identity_explanation: The gold issue concerns the orientation and optimality of the triangular Cholesky right factor in B^T A B. ISSUE-004 instead concerns an undefined or ambiguous omega-optimality claim and its diagonal-scaling interpretation; it does not diagnose the incorrect R^{-T} versus R^{-1} formula or the resulting condition measure.
